While it is still too soon to state unequivocally how this latest economic disaster came about, it is possible to theorize that much of what has happened could have been foreseen and even avoided--just as it could have been in 1929. This book accurately describes the economic situations in the United States before the 1929 and 2008-2009 stock market crashes, and carefully examines the causes of both financial crises. finance:openlibrary_api:OL9584683W.description: "Into the Red explores the emergence of a credit card market in post-Soviet Russia during the formative period from 1988 to 2007.
